newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower on bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower on bearish sentiment.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended lower on Tuesday amid bearish sentiment triggered by political uncertainty after the right-wing Jamaat-i-Islami announced boycott of February 3 general elections, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 2.80 points, or 0.21 percent, lower at 1,340.88, after falling to 1,333.13, just above the year low of 1,332.14 on September 10, 1996. Losers led gainers 169 to 65. The index fell in the absence of any support from financial institutions.
PTCL fell 0.65 rupee to 25.10, HUBCO 0.10 to 31.30, ICI 0.40 to 17 and MCB 2.75 to 30.25.
